sources.excerpt: Sentinel by Broughton Audio | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Broughton Audio Sentinel LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION PREAMP OVERDRIVE Description The Broughton Audio Sentinel is an original design MOSFET overdrive and distortion pedal that doubles as a versatile preamp featuring a parallel clean blend path. Housed in an extended metal enclosure, it features an eight-knob control layout consisting of gain, master, blend, low clip, bass, middle, middle frequency, and treble controls for deep frequency shaping. It incorporates true bypass switching to maintain signal transparency and can operate across a 9 to 24-volt DC power range for increased headroom. The circuit is designed to deliver rich harmonic saturation with active EQ capabilities suitable for both live pedalboards and studio direct applications.
